text:
maria: Heads up — ran a quick audit after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak. Observed a regression in tokens/sec and the $/M token estimate jumped. Posting rough numbers and profiling snippets below.

ajay: thanks — can you paste the before/after numbers?

maria: baseline (old policy) on p4d: 18.2k tokens/s (avg), GPU util ~92%, 1.2 ms/token internal avg. After selector change (prefer paged paths for long prefixes): 11.9k tokens/s, GPU util ~68%, 1.9 ms/token. ~53% drop in throughput.

taylor: that's big. how does that translate to $/M tokens?

maria: rough calc (instance cost normalized): baseline ~ $35 / M tokens, after ~ $52 / M tokens. (Assumes packing/slotting identical).

chen: can you share profiler snapshot? nvprof / nsight CLI stuff?

maria: pasted snippet from perf run:

```
Kernel timings (ms):
flash_attn_fwd:  4.8   (40%)
flash_attn_bwd:  3.2   (27%)
paged_attn_tile: 6.7   (56%)  <-- dominated more
kv_cache_copy:   0.8   (7%)
other:           1.1   (10%)
GPU util: 68%
SM stalls: high, likely memory-bound
```

ajay: looks like paged variant is causing higher memory traffic. any change in L2 hit rates or PCIe copies?

maria: L2 miss rate up ~18ppt. We see a lot more small memcpy operations in the trace; KV cache scatter/gather pattern increased.

perf-bot: automated snapshot: callsite heatmap attached (link: https://ci.redwood/trace/1765432100) :eyes:

chen: did the selector fall back to a fused path for short sequences or did it pick paged for everything?

maria: bug in selector rules: threshold comparison used strictly > instead of >=, so some edge cases (seq_len=512 near prefix cutoff) got pushed to paged. Repro script below:

```
# repro command
rdw-run --model=rwinf-1b --seq=512 --prefetch=on --kern-selector=auto --profile=nv
```

ajay: two quick mitigation ideas: 1) restore previous selector thresholds (hotfix), 2) change batching heuristic to bucket by effective_seq (so mixed batches don't force paged paths).

taylor: bucketed batching might help — keep short-context requests grouped so fused/flash kernels still hit. Could be a config toggle for Dedicated customers to avoid churn.

maria: ran a micro-test with bucketed batching (3 buckets: short<=256, mid<=1024, long>1024). Results: short bucket tokens/sec ~19k, mid ~15k, long ~7k. Overall cluster throughput improved vs naive mixed batches.

chen: nice. any KV behavior changes with bucket sharding? increased evictions?

maria: fewer random KV writes since similar lifetimes grouped: eviction rate down ~12%. Prefetch helps too.

ajay: cost projection if we roll bucketed batching globally: ~$38 / M tokens (vs $52 current, close to baseline). Worth a staged rollout + observability flags.

maria: suggested rollout plan:
- hotfix: revert strict comparator in selector (immediate)
- deploy bucketed batching as opt-in flag to Dedicated clusters (1 week)
- monitor tokens/sec, GPU util, L2 miss, eviction rate for 48h
- if stable, flip default for hosted (gradual)

perf-bot: regression alert created: RG-1765432100, assigned to @maria and @ajay :white_check_mark:

chen: small thought — we should also add a metric for effective_kernel_choice_ratio (fraction of requests hitting flash/fused vs paged) to console dashboards. Quick query: `sum(kernel_choice == "paged") / sum(total)`

maria: added a dashboard tile to the trial org. Will link after it's stable.

ajay: follow-ups: please paste the tiny pprof flamegraph link and the particular commit that changed selector logic. I'll prep the hotfix branch.

maria: commit: 1a2b3c4d selector: use >= -> > (oops). Flamegraph: https://ci.redwood/fg/1765432100. Pushing hotfix now.

sre-bot: deploy job queued: deploy/hotfix-selector -> staging (job 9845). Logs will post here.

maria: thanks all. will update after staging perf run (~30m). :coffee:
